title: Asian Games
metaDescription: The Asian Games bring athletes from across the continent together for a multi-sport programme hosted across Aichi and Nagoya

overview.about: The Asian Games are the second-largest multi-sport event in the world after the Olympics, bringing together thousands of athletes from across Asia every four years. The programme mixes Olympic sports with regional ones such as kabaddi, sepaktakraw and wushu. Nagoya, Japan hosts in 2026.
overview.nextEvent: The 2026 Asian Games are hosted in Nagoya, Japan, with athletes from more than 40 nations competing across dozens of sports. As at the Olympics, the medal table is topped by the continent's sporting powers.
